verdicts.reason: A: a reasonable left-to-right banner, but the logo floats alone above the centred text. The yellow circle is cropped awkwardly behind the CTA, and the phone sits right against the left and bottom edges. B has the same layout, but the headline's 'alive' almost touches the CTA button. The phone also runs into the top edge of the canvas, so the frame is clipped and the right side feels more cramped.
